• `Tap O repeatedly to run.`
• `Press X to jump over the hurdles.`
• `Jump in front of the bread and press`
`X again to grab it in your mouth.`
• `Pick up the matching item at the`
`table with X and run to the finish!`

original_japanese:
**Title**: `二人三脚 説明`
1. `◯ボタンと方向キーの右を交互に押すと`
　 `走ります。`
2. `パートナーとタイミングを合わせて`
　 `交互に押して下さい。`
3. `タイミングが合わないと転びます。`
4. `早くゴールした方が勝ちです。`

• `Alternate pressing O and Right`
`on the D-Pad to run.`
• `Match your partner's rhythm as`
`you alternate buttons.`
• `If your timing is off, you'll trip!`
• `First team to the finish line wins!`
